kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نرتبك (form VIII)
# نَرْتَبِكُ (nartabiku) /nar.ta.bi.ku/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَبَكَ (irtabaka)
# نَرْتَبِكَ (nartabika) /nar.ta.bi.ka/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَبَكَ (irtabaka)
# نَرْتَبِكْ (nartabik) /nar.ta.bik/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَبَكَ (irtabaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
